note: Empirically verified against the real local Supabase instance (all writes inside rolled-back transactions).

review_findings.summary: menu_versions has an unrestricted UPDATE RLS policy gated only on menu.write -- status can be set to 'published' directly, bypassing publish_menu_version()'s permission check, blocker validation, audit log, and the write-guard trigger entirely. Verified: a menu.write-only role published a blocker-laden draft directly.

membership_roles insert policy lets any users.manage holder assign the system 'owner' role to their own membership -- Manager can self-escalate to Owner (incl. payments.refund, roles.manage). create_invitation() has the same gap via unvalidated p_role_id.
SECURITY DEFINER function has no tenant-membership/permission check -- any authenticated user can read another tenant's unpublished dish names via this RPC. Verified cross-tenant leak.

review_findings.area: Epic 3/#8 unauthenticated side effect (regression from Claude's own P2 fix)
review_findings.summary: Reordering invite email-before-persist moved the send in front of the users.invite authorization check (which lives inside create_invitation()) -- any tenant member can trigger arbitrary invite emails; a failed RPC after send still leaves a dead, unusable invite.

Tickets #11-#15 shipped as DB-only with no admin UI, no image upload route, no Storage bucket/policy -- acceptance criteria requiring UI states are unimplemented. Public page references a /media/* route that doesn't exist.
get_public_menu() inserts an analytics_events row per call, granted to anon -- unbounded fake-metric inflation possible.
option_groups/options/ingredients/media_assets are not version-scoped and excluded from the write guard -- editing an option's price changes the live published menu instantly.
Raw single-use invite token logged via console.info when RESEND_API_KEY is unset.
Required E2E + automated a11y checks not added; disabled dish-detail button gives no programmatic reason for its state.
tenant.settings.write/menu.write/menu.read permission keys missing from domain-model.md and auth.md.
No uniqueness on (tenant_id, version_number) or one-draft-per-tenant constraint.
.limit(1) on memberships is wrong for multi-tenant users; accept_invitation surfaces raw Postgres errors on duplicate accept.

required_actions: Block direct menu_versions.status transitions -- publishing only possible through publish_menu_version() (critical).
Restrict owner-role assignment and invitation role selection to roles.manage/Owner (high).
Add a permission check to run_menu_publish_checks (high).
Move invitation authorization check ahead of the email send; add invite rate limiting (high).
Resolve the Epic 4 UI/storage scope gap: implement or formally re-scope #11-#15 (high).
Stop writing analytics_events from the anon-callable read function (medium).
Add missing E2E/a11y tests for #17/#18 and the cross-tenant regression tests named in the findings (medium).
